basis: Vascular insufficiency defines this umbrella; the ischemic target organ varies across subtypes.
Fibromuscular dysplasia directly affects the coronary arterial walls.
KLHL7-related Bohring-Opitz-like syndrome features severe neurodevelopmental impairment and congenital contractures.
Gastrointestinal hamartomatous polyposis and characteristic mucocutaneous pigmentation define PJS; associated cancers are separate diseases.
Benign lymphoid-cell proliferation resembling lymphoma; no specific anatomic site or autoimmune mechanism is established.
A peroxisome-biogenesis disorder presenting with hereditary ataxia; systemic features of other PEX16 phenotypes are not assumed.
ACTL6A-related BAFopathy is a neurodevelopmental disorder; consistent functional damage to additional organs is not established here.
Creatine biosynthesis deficiency is defined by cerebral creatine depletion, developmental impairment and myopathy; myopathy occurs in 30-79%.
Prostatic hyperplasia affects a reproductive organ; urinary symptoms do not establish common direct urinary tract damage.
PURA-related encephalopathy causes developmental impairment and brain abnormalities; respiratory distress and feeding difficulty do not establish organ injury.
Spastic paraplegia reflects spinal tract dysfunction; frequent spastic bladder is neurogenic, without documented intrinsic urinary tract injury.
Congenital intestinal sodium transport failure causes persistent secretory diarrhea; colitis occurs in 2/7 and is below the threshold.
Inherited retinal degeneration; no extraocular involvement is established for this subtype.
Impaired writing is a cerebral or neurodevelopmental functional deficit, consistent with the supplied definition and learning-disability ancestry.
Open cervical neural tube malformation involves spinal neural structures and defective vertebral closure.
Microcephaly/intellectual disability, microphthalmia and limb defects define MMEP; structural oral clefts occur in 80-99%; cardiac defects are occasional.
Inherited altered thyroid-hormone binding produces euthyroid hyperthyroxinemia; amyloid organ damage is not part of this phenotype.
Viral infection directly inflames the conjunctiva and causes conjunctival hemorrhage.
Renal tubular salt wasting defines Bartter type 1, with characteristic hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis; nephrocalcinosis remains within the renal axis.
Brain, eye and skeletal abnormalities define COFS; sensorineural hearing loss occurs in 1/3 reported patients; dental abnormalities omitted by cap.
Pneumocystis fungal infection directly causes pneumonia; underlying immunodeficiency is a predisposing separate condition.
Repetitive compulsive excoriation directly produces skin lesions.
Hair-shaft disease causes brittle beaded hair, alopecia and follicular hyperkeratosis.
Asphyxiating thoracic dysplasia combines severe skeletal malformation and pulmonary hypoplasia; renal and hepatic abnormalities lack established >=30% frequency.
The syndrome group is defined by structural oral-cavity abnormalities and mandibular or limb hypogenesis.
